newsitem.title: USA: affiliate leads $9mln Custom Foot financing.
newsitem.headline: affiliate leads $9mln Custom Foot financing.

text.p: Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette's venture capital affiliate Sprout Group said it closed the first round of a $9 million recapitalization for Custom Foot Inc of Westport, Conn.

Sprout Group said it is investing $4.5 million. It added it leads an investor group consisting of existing investors St. Paul Venture Partners, Marquette Ventures, Trinity Venture, Hambrecht & Quist and Phillips-Smith Ventures.
Sprout said Custom Foot is shoemaker offering more than 7,000 sizes per style, compared with a typical high-end retailer's offering 100 to 150 sizes per style.
